purpose: Specialist sidecar registry for richer Pi/NenFlow/orchestrate-run workflows. PEV remains the primary spine; these agents are optional specialists selected by phase, risk, and task type.
selection_rules: Use at most 1-3 sidecars for small tasks; avoid agent sprawl.
Sidecars do not replace canonical PEV artifacts unless the user explicitly chooses a non-PEV flow.
Only agents with agencyLevel=implementation may edit source/config/docs files.
Verifier sidecars advise; pev-verifier owns the final NenFlow PASS/FAIL verdict.
Observer/witness agents record evidence, drift, and artifact health; they do not judge correctness.
If a sidecar writes an artifact in a NenFlow run, use ATT_SIDE_<PHASE>_<AGENT>.md.
